ETag.description: Strong entity tag of the resource: the quoted `version`, for example `"3"`.

state.description:
Lifecycle state of a hint. `Active` moves to exactly one terminal state:
`Consumed` (a candidate was claimed by the hinted station), `Expired`
(`expiresAt` passed) or `Superseded` (a newer completion at the station
issued a newer hint, or cleared it).
state.title: HintState

afterTaskId.description: The completed task this hint follows.

originLocation.description: Where the station stood when the hint was issued.

policyVersion.description: The policy version the hint was computed with.

rank.description: 1 is the closest; ranked by detourM, then taskId.

taskType.description: A task type an interleaving hint may point at.
taskType.title: TaskType

location.description: The location the operator must go to first.

detourM.description: Rectilinear detour in metres, rounded to 0.1 m.

consumedTaskId.description: The candidate that was claimed; present only when Consumed.

400.description: Malformed JSON body, an unknown field, an invalid policy value, or an invalid path or query parameter.

value.title: State is invalid
